title: Mémoire en chiffre du XIIe décembre 1560: anonymous report from the Agenais to Montmorency, BnF fr. 3157 no. 67

steps.what: Located item 67 in fr. 3157: the BnF notice's folio numbers precede the item numbers, so the cipher is ff. 152r-156v (not f. 158). Fetched the ten pages from Gallica IIIF.
Checked the dorse and the neighbouring Villars letters for a decipherment or key: none.
Looked at Lasry's GL.htm tables for Henri II / Charles IX as the brief asked: different symbol sets.
Three agents transcribed the ten pages into ASCII sign codes (one stopped after three pages by a tool block; a fresh agent did 153v-154r).
One-sign-per-letter homophonic annealing with word spaces: gibberish (-4.2/char).
z followed by o in 262 of 283 cases: 'zo' taken as one unit; most frequent words Tzox, Wx, Wxm, hx.
Seeded Tzox=que, Wx/Wxm=le/les, hx=de; annealer read 'les derniers advertissemens', 'les affaires de pardeça'.
Aligned decrypted words with the French they must be: entendu (r=n, io=u), avoir, ordinairement (s3=r), souloit (nn=s); reran the annealer with these units (-3.2/char).
Standalone groups read from context as codes: Z=pour, 4=roy, c+/i+/e+=et, F/g=sieur.
Key-guided correction pass by four agents against the images, changing a sign only where the image supports it: about 300 x->r fixes, the looped sign y (=i) identified, missing signs restored.
Line-by-line reading with marked emendations; lz=d found during it (despuis, disans, d'environ); 16 of 1,715 cipher words left unread.
Web search for an edition or decipherment (names, places, shelfmark): none; Brunet 2019 on Clairac not reachable.

Merged with a parallel project pass on the same item (main 13e0f27b2): its margin (153r.14, 'assemblez en la chambre du conseil') and dorse ('Advertissemens') readings decoded with key.txt and confirmed; added to the reading.

outcome.method_basis: The homophonic cipher with two-stroke units of BnF fr. 3157 item 67 (ff. 152r-156v) was broken from the images alone: 'zo' taken as one unit from statistics, probable short words (que, le, les, de) seeded into an annealer, then words aligned against the French they had to be; no decipherment, key or edition exists.
outcome.fraction_read_source: reading_152r-154r.txt + reading_154v-156v.txt against ciphertext.txt: 16 words marked [..] out of 1,715 cipher words (108 more read with a marked emendation).
outcome.notes: Key broken here ciphertext-only. Content fits the Agenais in Dec 1560: Clairac assembly, Caumont, Biron at Bergerac, Navarre at Nérac, the États of Orléans deputies. Writer unnamed.

prior.where: No DECODE record, not on Tomokiyo or Lasry (GL.htm) lists, no edition found by web search. Brunet 2019 on Clairac not reachable.

human: Project-level: posed the catalogue entry with /goal. No target-specific intervention.
